paragraphs: Nuventive sells planning and improvement software for higher education institutions, covering strategic planning, accreditation, learning outcomes, and program review. The product is the Nuventive Improvement Platform, which combines planning, measurement, and outcomes information in the same screen.

The platform is used by institutions large and small to drive planning and progress for strategic, assessment, and improvement initiatives. Listed initiatives include overall strategic planning, accreditation, program review, learning outcomes assessment, and administrative outcomes assessment. It is built and hosted on Microsoft Azure and is offered as a fully configurable, cloud-based solution. Customer stories and webinars on that page name Arcadia University, Oklahoma State University, Skyline College, and HACC: Central Pennsylvania's Community College.

Nuventive has helped higher education institutions across the country since 2000. Its software and services solutions are used by large and small institutions and by stakeholders from cabinet members to faculty and staff.

quote.text: Nuventive gives faculty and staff access to the best available information, a continuous feedback loop and a platform for delivering results.
